title: MCD212 display-parameter BP mapping
symptom: Philips cp_dprm(BP_DOUBLE) emits 0x78000500, but E-Di masks the command to its low five bits. The captured Validation Disc CLUT 4 High Res state therefore leaves DCR.CM clear even though the guest explicitly requests four-bit double/high-resolution pixels.
expected: The load-display-parameters instruction maps the Philips Green Book BP, PRF, and RMS fields to MCD212 color mode, mosaic factor, and file type without disc-specific inference. BP_DOUBLE selects the four-bit double/high-resolution channel mode.
revalidation_reason: The Philips Validation Disc capture contains the exact command 0x78000500 and ICM CLUT4, while the pre-correction MCD212 snapshot recorded DCR.CM clear. Green Book Figure V.49 and Philips' ucm.h cp_dprm macro place BP at bits 9:8, PRF at 3:2, and RMS at 1:0. ICA and DCA tests now exercise those Philips-authored fields: BP_DOUBLE sets DCR.CM, BP_NORMAL clears it, and PRF/RMS populate DDR independently. Revalidate if the command decoder, color-mode use, or extended BP_HIGH support changes.

input_events: capture a stationary Filled Solid frame

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: CD-RTOS/UCM writes the Green Book cp_dprm layout directly into ICA/DCA. On base MCD212 hardware, BP_NORMAL clears DCR.CM and BP_DOUBLE sets it; PRF and RMS retain their low-four-bit mapping into DDR. The shortened bit diagram in Motorola Table 5-11 does not show the fixed bit 10 or BP field used by Philips software.
supporting_evidence: Green Book Figure V.49 places BP at bits 9:8, PRF at bits 3:2, and RMS at bits 1:0.
Philips ucm.h defines _OP_DPRM as 0x78000400 and cp_dprm as BP shifted by eight, PRF by two, and RMS unshifted.
The Philips Validation Disc emits 0x78000500 for its CLUT 4 High Res frame.
MCD212 Tables 5-2, 6-5, 9-11, and 9-14 state that CM selects four bits/pixel and double horizontal resolution.
contradicting_evidence: Motorola MCD212 Table 5-11 depicts CM, MF1, MF2, FT1, and FT2 in the low five command bits.
Current MAME and the existing E-Di implementation copy only the low five bits.
E-Di's CLUT4 decoder currently derives packed-pixel expansion from ICM, so the Validation Disc image appears correct despite stale DCR.CM.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Execute Philips commands 0x78000400 and 0x78000500 through both ICA and DCA. If BP_DOUBLE does not select DCR.CM on real hardware or another authoritative Philips implementation, retain the low-bit mapping and document the Green Book-to-MCD212 translation boundary. Otherwise require BP_DOUBLE to set CM while preserving PRF/RMS behavior.
citations: Green Book Release 2, Figure V.49 Load Display Parameters Instruction
Philips/Microware ucm.h in FPD804, FPD805, and CD-i developer-disc source: _OP_DPRM and cp_dprm
Philips Validation Disc Europe Disc 1 capture, plane A RAM offset 0x23cf0

context.scenario: synthetic ICA/DCA commands matching Philips cp_dprm plus captured Validation Disc command
context.timing: ICA at field start and one DCA line

experiments.strategy: Add a failing test for captured command 0x78000500, then decode BP from bits 9:8 while preserving PRF/RMS in bits 3:0. Cover BP_DOUBLE and BP_NORMAL through both ICA and DCA.
assumptions: Mono-I supports Green Book BP_NORMAL and BP_DOUBLE; BP_HIGH remains an extended-case mode outside this device.
The fixed bit 10 in Philips _OP_DPRM is opcode structure, not part of BP.
experiments.expected: 0x78000500 selects DCR.CM without changing DDR PRF/RMS, while 0x78000400 clears DCR.CM; low PRF/RMS values remain independent.
experiments.actual: The pre-correction test failed because DCR.CM remained clear. After decoding the Philips fields, ICA and DCA tests pass for BP_NORMAL, BP_DOUBLE, PRF, and RMS; all 100 cdi-core tests pass.
improvements: MCD212 register state now matches Philips-authored display commands.
Removed dependence on the MAME-style low-five-bit interpretation for BP.
Preserved the validated framebuffer output path without title-specific behavior.

conditions: Mono-I MCD212 Green Book BP_NORMAL and BP_DOUBLE commands
invalidated_by: Implementation of extended-case BP_HIGH or a different video decoder
repeat_when: DCR.CM begins driving additional pixel-fetch or geometry behavior

manual_verification.notes: The opt-in capture records command 0x78000500 at plane-A RAM offset 0x23cf0, ICM CLUT4, and DCR.CM clear. This incident concerns register/command fidelity, not the authored static lines, which were independently resolved as correct.
A failing ICA test reproduced the stale CM bit before correction. ICA and DCA now pass Philips cp_dprm field tests, and the full cdi-core suite passes 100 tests.
